product_one_liner.value: Orange Logic is an enterprise digital asset management and content orchestration platform that helps marketing, creative, and media teams organize, govern, automate, and deliver digital content.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page or pricing navigation link was found; the site directs buyers to a demo, and its platform comparison describes pricing as custom and scoped to requirements.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 278 employees and a 201–500 company-size band.

founded_year.notes: Current company materials state 1998; the older 2023 financing announcement used 2000.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog is a marketing/product/news publication; no separate engineering blog with at least two engineer-authored build-focused posts was identified.

public_docs.notes: The public developer documentation index contains multiple API, authentication, integration, webhook, and AI articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Applied AI Product Engineer is listed among current openings.

model_provider.notes: Orange Logic announces Nemotron integration in Agent Studio and separately states customers can run search and tagging on AWS, Google, or OpenAI; these are supported choices, not a single mandatory provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The page names SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO/IEC 27001 as assurance standards, and HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI DSS as regulatory coverage; the latter are compliance claims, not all formal certifications.

last_funding.notes: Bregal Sagemount investment announced May 16, 2023; the USD amount was not disclosed.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest publicly recorded round is May 16, 2023, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current openings list includes no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: Orange Builder was introduced September 30, 2026; NVIDIA Nemotron integration in Agent Studio was announced September 8, 2026. Both fall within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On August 14, 2026, Orange Logic announced founder Karl Facredyn had returned as Interim CEO, succeeding Brian McLaughlin.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Marketing Operations Manager posting requires expert-level HubSpot marketing automation and CRM proficiency; the privacy notice also names HubSpot among technology providers used in business operations. Alternative tools mentioned only as preferred experience are not treated as deployed systems.
